we present a new spacetime formulation of the Einstein-Hilbert action in terms of the SU(2) connection and the triad, which is invariant under the local SU(2) group of gauge transformations and the diffeomorphism group, and which reduces to the Einstein-Hil- bert action in the classical limit.

(i) we have constructed a Lagrangian formulation in the SU(2) connection variables, (ii) we have found a new first-class constraint that is the generator of spatial diffeomorphisms, (iii) we have found that the Barbero-Immrizi parameter? does not appear in the Hamiltonian constraint, (iv) we have constructed an explicit solution of the Hamiltonian constraint for a spatially flat Friedmann-Robertson-Walker universe, and

we have constructed a spacetime gauge covariant Lagrangian for gravity, which is equivalent to the Einstein-Hilbert action, in terms of the spacetime Barbero-Immrizi connection and the spacetime triad.

the study of the properties of a class of noncommutative field theories.
the study of a new gauge covariant Lagrangian for general relativity, which is a function of SU(2) connection and its curvature on spacetime.
the study of the Lagrangian formulation and the corresponding field equations for the gravitational field in the context of the so-called Barbero-Immmirzi (BI) theory of gravity.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a new spacetime Lagrangian formulation for general relativity by introducing a spacetime connection field and its conjugate momentum field, and that the Lagrangian is invariant under spacetime diffeomorphism, SU(2) gauge transformations, and the first class constraints.
we have developed a new spacetime formulation of general rela- tivity, and we have shown that this spacetime theory of general relativity is equivalent to its standard spacetime formulation.
